rule: STAGE2_TRACKB_PLAN rule Z2, G9-ref (kinematic only; before the first closed-loop episode on the set and body): (a) every frozen reference played kinematically at the commanded clock passes its own item's readings, the quick turn also reaching 80 degrees at the slowest clock (the bar's reference check, cited); (b) on each rung the look ladder holds for the body the walk's playback agrees with the ladder's numbers (bob within 5 %, head pitch within 0.1 degree, tail phase within 0.01 cycle, toe-off within 0.02 rad and within 10 % of the ladder's number) and the set's look-format hash for that rung equals L1_FREEZE.json's; on a rung the ladder does not hold the four numbers are finite with at least 4 steps in the window; on an -X body each walk's playback agrees with the plain body's playback of the same rung within the same limits; for every walk and turn item the playback of its window (U2) holds at least 4 steps and 4 lift-offs; on V6noF5 no hash and no toe-off comparison (the toe-off 'not read'), bob, head and tail against the same body's V6 playback; (c) four degraded playbacks each fail exactly their term (bob x 0.5; a 3 degree neck sinusoid; the tail 0.2 cycle late; flat feet, on V6 only), the unchanged playback passes all four with ratio 1, a playback cut to 3 steps reads too_few_steps, and (the lead's ruling 2 of TRACKB_RULINGS6_16NOV) the tail scaled to a tenth about its mean fails the tail term and no other; (f) each reference no bar item plays has its screen record cited, every task's track is continuous at its joins and plays 2 s with finite targets: [changed after a result (rule Z2's label: changed after G9's result): the lead's ruling 15 of 17 Nov 2026 (ROUND_C_RULINGS_17NOV.md), made after the numbers the joins gave on Stage 1's own arrays (up to 1.1e-4 rad) and on V0 (up to 5.3e-5 rad), seen on 17 Nov, where nothing is wrong, and before any look set was frozen and before any closed-loop episode on one; as first written: joint targets within 1e-6 rad] a join's jump at a joint does not exceed the largest change between two consecutive frames of the walk it leaves, at that joint (a join never adds a step larger than the walk's own motion); the gate records both numbers per join and joint.  If (a) fails for a reference it is treated as not available and goes to the lead; [the lead's ruling 14 of 17 Nov 2026] G9-ref fails while a failing item's reference is still available in the set, and its record names those references: the lead marks them not available, freezes the set again and runs G9-ref again; a failing start, nominal or v0.4 blocks the body and head; if (b), (c) or (f) fails no closed-loop episode runs on that set and body.  The gates list each item's reference toe-off and its side of 0.02 rad (the lead's ruling 7 of 16 Nov 2026).  This module's own reading, which is not the rule's wording: G9-ref reads a frozen set (any set but the Stage 1 view): an unfrozen set is refused, and every file parts (b) and (c) play, and the comparand's walks, is checked against the latest freeze (setio.read_inputs, require_frozen) before anything is played (a file that differs is refused); the record lists them with their sha256 and those (f)'s library read (inputs).  (a) cites the refcheck record the set's latest freeze cites when its sha256 is the cited one, else the set directory's refcheck.json when every file it read has the latest freeze's sha256, else bar.refcheck is run; whichever record is read, one given by path included, must be of the set and body and every file it read must have the latest freeze's sha256, else (a) is not read and blocks.  An item that fails names its own reference (a walk item its walk, a turn or stop item its move, the last move of the item's plan in the plan's order: the lead's ruling 32 (D) of 17 Nov 2026) and a failing walk/nominal or walk/v0.4 item blocks; the start is played by every item and alone by none, so a failing start is read through the walk/nominal item (the start and the nominal walk alone) and blocks through it.  A failing item's reference is still available while its entry is usable as the env and the bar read it (r5lib.why_not: an entry with a file, not recorded as not available) or the set's latest freeze lists it; one that cannot be named counts as still available (still_available).  (b) plays each walk alone (whole windows of its file) over the reference times [2.0, 2.0 + 10 x 1.05] s through lookread.playback; a rung's walk is the entry whose ladder_twin names the rung, else nominal and v0.4 by name; its numbers are compared with the ladder rung its entry names as its twin (the rung of L1_FREEZE where it names none); a rung of the ladder the set does not hold fails (b) for nominal and v040 and is listed for any other.  An -X body's and V6noF5's walks are compared by name with the comparand set's walks of the same name (the comparand's files cited by path and their own sha256).  The items are the bar's walk and turn conditions at mu 0.9 that the set holds (a mu 0.54 item plays the same track).  (c) is made on the playbacks of the walks nominal and v0.4, with lookread.controls' window (the lead of lookread.LEAD_S before it).  (f): a reference no reference check plays is one that no item of the cited refcheck record that was done names among its files; its block in the set's screen.json must exist with the entry's hash (a walk: its look-format file).  A join's jump at a joint is the |difference| of that joint's target between segment i at its own end (its own formula at its full duration) and segment i + 1's first frame.  The walk it leaves is the walk (a periodic segment) segment i plays; where segment i is no walk (the start, a move or a hold), the walk the track played last before the join (the walk it left through that move), else the first walk it plays after the join; a track that plays no walk holds its joins to 0 at every joint.  A walk's largest change at a joint is over every two consecutive frames of its file's window as the track plays them, the last frame to the first included; 'does not exceed' is at most (<=).  The zero-action targets are R5Tracker.zero_command at every physics step of 2 s of simulated time at the commanded clock.
